method: RAD-002 1-D free-strain screen on the RAD-DATUM rig: integrated alpha(T), per-joint seams, front-edge datum on cassette 10, truss datum schemes AFT/FRONT/SPLIT, truss temperature swept; no stiffness, friction, creep, bond, pressure or load.
joint_numbering: joint j on frame j between cassettes j and j+1 from aft; joint 9 = frame 9 at X 62.934, the front-most seam

CC_composite.note: in-plane, axial fibres; through-thickness CTE several times higher

alpha_sources.CC_composite: in-plane C/C, axial fibres, layup dependent (~0-1e-6 /K near RT rising to ~2-3e-6 /K hot; e.g. Savage, Carbon-Carbon Composites, 1993); through-thickness several times higher
alpha_sources.SiC: sintered/CVD SiC (Munro 1997, J. Phys. Chem. Ref. Data 26:1195; ~3.3-3.6e-6 /K near RT, ~5.5-6e-6 /K near 1800 K)
alpha_sources.W: tungsten (Touloukian TPRC vol. 12; White & Minges 1997, Int. J. Thermophys. 18:1269; ~4.4e-6 /K RT, ~5.5-6e-6 /K hot)
alpha_sources.Mo_TZM: Mo/TZM (Touloukian TPRC vol. 12; ~5e-6 /K RT, ~7-7.5e-6 /K near 1800 K)
alpha_sources.Nb_C103: Nb C-103 (Touloukian TPRC vol. 12 for Nb; C-103 producer data ~7e-6 /K RT, ~9e-6 /K near 1800 K)
alpha_sources.owner_equivalent: secant 5.46e-6 /K = the owner ~1.5 m aggregate over 182.149 m (40!A64), not a material (15!H122)
